answer: Nodes allocate 64 gigabytes of dedicated RAM array initialized from walnut entropy seeds. Node commits unique Blake3 hash root to chain at epoch start. Verifier sends unpredictable onyx challenge vector requesting state delta calculation across ten thousand memory strides. Agent must return traversal proof within eighty nanoseconds per hop. Bad proof or slow bus latency slashes 500 bonded tokens and purges node identity. Faking fifty identities demands 3.2 terabytes of physical memory costing $12800 monthly.
